portable_evidence.claim: The spectral width (SW) is calculated as SW*SFO1.
portable_evidence.source_context:
CLASS ACQU
 SUBRANGE 0.0 1e8
 REL "SWH=SW*SFO1"
 INV_REL "SW=SWH/SFO1"
 UNIT "Hz"

portable_evidence.claim: The digital resolution (FIDRES) is calculated as SW*SFO1/TD.
portable_evidence.source_context:
CLASS ACQU
 SUBRANGE 0.0 100000
 REL "FIDRES=SW*SFO1/TD"
 INV_REL "TD = nextpow(SW*SFO1/FIDRES)"
 UNIT "Hz"

portable_evidence.claim: The acquisition time (AQ) is calculated as aqcalc(SW,SFO1,TD,DIGTYP).
portable_evidence.source_context:
CLASS ACQU
 SUBRANGE 0.0 1000
 REL "AQ=aqcalc(SW,SFO1,TD,DIGTYP)"
 INV_REL "TD=tdcalc(SW,SFO1,1.0e6*AQ,DIGTYP)"
 UNIT "sec"

portable_evidence.claim: The digital width (DW) is calculated as 1/(2*SW*SFO1).
portable_evidence.source_context:
TYPE R32

 REL "DW=1/(2*SW*SFO1)"
 INV_REL "SW=1000000/(2*(0.005+DW)*SFO1)"
 UNIT "usec"
